tips.text: Refine the Systems relics to Radiant and leave Common relics Intact; Radiant lowers Common odds to 16.67%.
Pick a teammate's identical reward at the reward screen; you keep the item and they get 5 bonus Void Traces.
Buy extra relics for Wyrm Prime Systems; it is the Uncommon in every one of them.
Bank Aya before her rotation opens; it never expires.
Free two Companion slots before the final build; the Prime and its Prime Laser Rifle each take one.
